GaugeFixingFunctional_strict_B1_v1.symbolic_expression: -Derivative(A0(t, x, y, z), t) + Derivative(A1(t, x, y, z), x) + Derivative(A2(t, x, y, z), y) + Derivative(A3(t, x, y, z), z)

FaddeevPopovOperator_strict_B1_v1.derivation: delta G[A + eps*partial alpha]/delta eps at eps=0
FaddeevPopovOperator_strict_B1_v1.operator_on_alpha: -Derivative(alpha(t, x, y, z), (t, 2)) + Derivative(alpha(t, x, y, z), (x, 2)) + Derivative(alpha(t, x, y, z), (y, 2)) + Derivative(alpha(t, x, y, z), (z, 2))
